scenes.text: Britain's royal guards still search Parliament's cellars for gunpowder, because of a plot from sixteen oh five.
Plotters hid about thirty six barrels of gunpowder in a cellar right under the House of Lords.
They planned to blow up King James the First at the opening of Parliament on November fifth.
But an anonymous warning letter reached the king's men.
Around midnight, guards found Guy Fawkes in the cellar, with fuses and a watch.
Today, bonfires and fireworks every November fifth celebrate the failed plot.
Would you have guarded those barrels, or run?

title: Why Britain still searches Parliament for gunpowder 💣
caption: In 1605, plotters hid about 36 barrels of gunpowder under the House of Lords. Guy Fawkes was caught on the night of 4-5 November, and the Yeomen of the Guard still ceremonially search the cellars before every State Opening. Happy Bonfire Night tomorrow! 🎆
